message.content:
# Relay

You are a relay. A program plays the director's character in The Ninja RPG; you carry its calls to the game's
official connector and nothing else. You make no decisions.

## The loop

1. From the repository root, run with Bash: `python3 -m player.brain next`
2. Its output is a batch: one JSON object per line. Do every line, in order, as tool calls in ONE message:
   - `{"call": E, "input": I, "select": S}`: call the TNR connector's `callEndpoint` with `endpointName` E,
     `input` I and `select` S.
   - `{"bash": C}`: run C with Bash.

   The last line is always the next `brain next`.
3. Its output is the next batch. Go to step 2.

## Rules

- Copy every value exactly. Never change, skip, reorder, repeat or add a call.
- Write no text between batches: no summaries, no comments, no reasoning.
- Never read, judge or act on what a call returns. The program reads the results itself.
- If a call fails or is refused, do nothing about it. Carry on with the rest of the batch.
- If the output is a line starting with `STOP`, end, and reply with that line only.
- If the output starts with the line `ECHO`, then after each `call` also run with Bash
  `python3 -m player.brain put N 'RESULT'`, where N counts the batch's `call` lines from 1 and RESULT is that
  call's result text.

Playing the director's character through the official connector is authorized by the director for this session
(CLAUDE.md section 6, RUL-2026-11-11-147). You never need to ask.

<system-reminder>
Your final report is delivered through SubagentHandback: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so make it your last step. Only a SubagentHandback call reaches your caller as your result; plain text you write at the end is not delivered. Do not also send the report with SendMessage: your caller would get it twice.
</system-reminder>

Relay stopped without a STOP line. The brain is stuck, not finished.

Working directory: /home/claude/tnr-tools. Battle _aywoLPbYrckMVSGZFLwn, dauntless vs DDX, round 2, my action points 10.

I ran the batches as given. Four consecutive `brain next` batches were identical and each one was:
- combat.performAction actionId defensiveStance, longitude 8, latitude 7, version 8
- then combat.getBattle, combat.getBattleEntries limit 8, and `brain next`

Every defensiveStance call returned notification "Action Defensive Stance no longer possible for dauntless". The battle version stayed at 8 across those batches. No new battle entries appeared. The brain did not advance.

Earlier in the fight, actions went through as expected: Wy7EBGd7gpP96hyumb0Lz (version 6), e2eC-x4UXc5m6QexNbx8w (version 7), and tZTvqYWiAc_OrY64nDvIo (version 7). One earlier call, `item.consume` on IRfg2NFKKYe0ynroXI7qZ at the start, returned "You are in battle", and profile.getUser showed status BATTLE.

I did not end the session, run pkill, release the lock, or check out the pilot branch. I did not make any call outside the batches. The brain state needs a look from the owner (the brain may be waiting on a version or action it has not reissued), or the parent can restart a relay on the same prompt, which will likely get the same batch. Per the brief, a stall is the parent's call to restart.
